  {"step":7,"file":"src/libopensc/card-tcos.c","function":"tcos_construct_fci","line":180,"var":"buf/n","code":"memcpy(buf, file->prop_attr, n);","note":"The vulnerable FCI builder copies attacker-influenced file metadata into a fixed-size stack buffer without an explicit bounds check."},

  {"step":9,"file":"src/libopensc/card-tcos.c","function":"tcos_construct_fci","line":201,"var":"out/p","code":"sc_asn1_put_tag(0x86, buf, n, p, sizeof (buf), &p);","note":"The oversized metadata is serialized into the APDU payload, which is the memory-safety sink candidate."}
]
